                                      "json":  "### ðŸ“– Help \u0026 Overview - Azure Tenant Certificate Monitoring\r\n\r\nThis workbook queries Azure Resource Graph (ARG) in real time across all selected subscriptions in your tenant.\r\n\r\n#### Covered Certificate Asset Types:\r\n1. **App Service Certificates (`microsoft.web/certificates`)**: Custom SSL certificates uploaded or managed for App Services.\r\n2. **App Service Certificate Orders (`microsoft.web/certificateorders`)**: Managed GoDaddy / DigiCert orders through Azure, with auto-renew tracking.\r\n3. **Web Apps \u0026 Custom Domain SSL Bindings (`microsoft.web/sites`)**: Maps App Service \u0026 Function App custom hostnames to their bound certificates, thumbprints, and live expiration dates.\r\n4. **Application Gateways (`microsoft.network/applicationgateways`)**: SSL termination certificates, identifying whether they use **Azure Key Vault with auto-rotation** or **manually uploaded blobs**.\r\n5. **API Management (`microsoft.apimanagement/service`)**: Custom domain endpoint certificates (Gateway, Portal, Management) and Key Vault integrations.\r\n6. **Azure Front Door \u0026 CDN (`microsoft.cdn/profiles/customdomains`)**: Edge TLS configurations and custom domain validation status.\r\n7. **Azure Key Vaults (`microsoft.keyvault/vaults`)**: Posture review (Soft Delete, Purge Protection) and Diagnostic Logging recommendations.\r\n\r\n\u003e [!NOTE]\r\n\u003e Azure Resource Graph requires Reader role on target subscriptions to read resource metadata.",
